ModName: GBFR Extra Sigil Slots - Reloaded ImGui (ER 2.0.2-2.0.5)
ModDescription: Reloaded-II-only configurable extra-sigil selector for ER 2.0.2-2.0.5 with 1-24 virtual slots, per-character named presets and preset transfer, protected virtual-slot sigils, usage filters, a compact bilingual UI, Chinese IME support, localized character names, and a Reloaded-II configurable hotkey (F8 by default). No ReShade or Luma dependency.
